scores.notes: Saul at left in robe has just released the spear, which flies past behind David's neck toward the right wall; David dodges in tunic, lamps and smoke wisps present. Window shows a town rather than open hills, minor; no lettering or blank edges.

Jerusalem is drawn with two separate Herodian-style temples, one on the left hilltop city and another atop the walled complex upper right, a contradictory place. Young man, dropped jar and resting figures right are present, but he looks neither weary nor bowed.
The foreground marker at left carries carved pseudo-Latin letters ('ROMA… S… ONS…') and the second marker has faint marks. Cream unpainted paper border around all edges (accepted).
Alice in pinafore with clasped hands faces the grinning Cheshire Cat seated on a mossy bough, teeth visible, cottage faintly in the background. Not a film likeness; edges painted, no lettering.

Moses with raised hand and Aaron in breastplate stand left, a pig roots at far left, families by tents and pots at right, tabernacle enclosure behind. Moses' gesture is not clearly at the hoof and the cloud/fire radiance is absent, minor omissions; no lettering.

Moses sits on a stone but raises his own right arm and holds the staff aloft unaided; Aaron's hand only rests behind his upper arm and Hur's hand hovers at his chest, so the verse's holding-up of his hands is not shown. Battle and Joshua at lower left are fine.

The two seraphim are human-bodied with only four visible wings, bare uncovered feet, and the right one wields tongs with a burning coal (a later verse); six wings covering face and feet are not shown. God appears only as radiance; carved cherub panels on the doors are decoration.

The Queen of Hearts (left) has the animated-film look: black hair bun, tiny crown, towering white stand-up collar and red heart-patterned gown. Otherwise the King crouches behind Alice, the floating Cat head is top centre, and card courtiers fill the lawn; small Alice-like girls in the background are minor.
Darius kneels pressing his signet into red wax on the stone over the pit, lords in embroidered robes stand around, torches and lamps at night. The wax seal pattern is not lettering; edges painted.

Ezekiel stands among scattered bones with arm raised in a barren valley with haze; the tablet he holds is blank. Some bones retain brown dried tissue but it is not lingering gore; no inscriptions seen on the stones.

Paul holds a bronze mirror at chest height in a colonnaded courtyard with believers on both sides, oil lamp and closed scrolls on the ledge at right. Scrolls and the temple frieze show no legible glyphs; edges painted.

Peter in the right foreground looks across the night courtyard toward Jesus standing by the gate, brazier centre, bystanders and torches around. Peter is not right at the brazier and carries an odd net and crook, minor; no lettering.

Egyptian chariots and horsemen charge down a wet seabed between walls of water under a dark sky with dawn at the far end. The water walls read more like breaking surf and no Israelites are clearly visible far off, minor; no lettering.

Holmes at right is a gaunt, hollow-cheeked profile with slicked-back hair that reads as a Peter Cushing screen likeness. Otherwise Hatherley points with a bandaged hand at the burning house with fire-engines and hoses; both of his hands are bandaged, a minor inconsistency.
Daniel stands small on a dark plain with hands raised toward flaming wheels and cloud radiance; no figure is drawn within the light. A ziggurat city sits on the horizon; no lettering.

The card soldiers carry corner indices ('A', 'V'/'J'-like glyphs) on the spade cards centre-right, and the Queen at right copies the animated-film costume (black bun, tall stand-up collar, red bodice with yellow heart skirt). The soldiers also walk hand in hand rather than forming arches.

Alice looks up at the Cheshire Cat's head floating centre-right, the flamingo lies on the grass beside her, hedgehogs and mushrooms at right, card soldiers and arches on the lawn. Card pips only, no index glyphs I could read; edges painted.

Elderly Adam lies on a woven mat with eyes closed, a woman kneeling beside him and family standing behind, tents, a well, fields and a mud-brick settlement at dusk. Only one hand rests on his chest, minor; no lettering.
Two walled mud-brick cities burn under streaks of falling fire and sulfur, smoke columns rising, small fleeing figures at the left and right edges. No lettering, full-bleed painting.

Moses with staff leads a file of Israelites carrying bundles between towering walls of water, pillar of fire glowing far behind. Viewed from the front rather than from behind, and a walled town sits on the far ridge, minor; no lettering, edges painted.

Peter grips the lame man's right hand and lifts him from a crouch beside the bronze temple gate; John stands right, crowd and two Roman soldiers behind, Temple in the background. Hands are well formed; no lettering.

Holmes in a dressing gown on the bed strikes a match and lashes his cane toward the bell-pull below the glowing ventilator; Watson sits with a pistol, and an adder is on the bell-pull. Holmes' gaunt face is generic rather than a clear actor likeness; the framed picture on the wall is not a border.

Lion, ox, man and eagle creatures with eye-covered wings stand around an empty throne above a crystal sea, rainbow and lightning behind; God is not drawn. The man-faced creature is part of the text's four; no lettering.
